indicator_definition: Share of total equivalised disposable income received by the bottom 40% of the income distribution, expressed as a percentage. Higher share indicates more equal distribution. Data from EU-SILC.
rationale: Monitoring the bottom 40% income share directly measures inclusive growth. Progress means an increasing income share for the poorest 40%.
methodology_characteristics: Data collected through EU-SILC. Equivalised disposable income ranked and cumulative share of bottom 40% calculated. Published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Income share of the bottom 40% of the population
graph_title: Income share of the bottom 40% of the population
